# Le fichier de projet annoté

Annoter un fichier ``.jenga`` :
* Types;
* Sources;
* Dépendances;
* Filtres;
* Tets;

Marquer d'un `?` tout ce qui est incompréhensible.

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-

# kodesi – Jenga Workspace
# Generated by `jenga workspace` on 2026-09-08 08:41:03

from Jenga import *

with workspace("kodesi"):
    configurations(['Debug', 'Release'])
    targetoses([TargetOS.WINDOWS])
    targetarchs([TargetArch.X86_64])
    
    # Default toolchain (auto-detected)
    # usetoolchain("host-gcc")
    
    # Uncomment to use Unitest testing framework
    # with unitest() as u:
    #     u.Precompiled()
    
    # Add your projects here
    # with project("MyApp"):
    #     consoleapp()
    #     language("C++")
    #     files(["src/**.cpp"])

    # Project: test_jenga
    with project("test_jenga"):
        consoleapp()
        language("C++")
        cppdialect("C++17")
        location("test_jenga")
        files(["src/**.cpp", "include/**.hpp"])

```
